standard_prerequisites: The section construction carried as context span: X a smooth connected affine curve over C, g : Y -> X finite of degree 3 with fibre over x equal to an unramified point u (degree 1) and a ramified point y (degree 2), U = Y \ {y} and f = g|_U : U -> X etale surjective with f^{-1}(x) = {u}
Discrete valuation rings, ramification indices, connected components of smooth curves; fibres of finite morphisms
core_obligations: Assume a tower W_m -> ... -> W_0 = X of open immersions and finite etale morphisms with a lift W_m -> U; reduce to smooth connected W_k via connected components

Z_i = Y x_X W_i is a disjoint union of smooth connected curves, Z_i -> W_i finite of degree 3, fibre over w_i has two points z_i (ramified of degree 2) and v_i (unramified); n_i = #pi_0(Z_i) in {1, 2}, non-decreasing, n_0 = 1 and n_m >= 2 because Z_m -> W_m has a section

At the minimal jump i: W_i -> W_{i-1} must be finite etale and Z_i = W_i disjoint-union Z'_i with Z'_i -> W_i of degree 2; the induced dominant map W_i -> Z_{i-1} between connected curves finite over W_{i-1} is surjective, giving DVR extensions O(W_{i-1}, w_{i-1}) -> O(Z_i, z_i) -> O(W_i, z) that are ramified then unramified - impossible
proof_roadmap: Set up the tower and the base-changed curves Z_i; count components n_i and locate the minimal index where n jumps from 1 to 2
Analyse the jump: open immersion impossible, so finite etale; split Z_i = W_i coproduct Z'_i and dominate Z_{i-1}
Derive the ramified-then-unramified DVR extension contradiction
